newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices firm at weekly auction.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm at the weekly tea auction on Monday on strong demand, auction officials said.
Brighter, medium and lower medium BP1s gained up to nine U.S cents while brighter PF1s were dearer by 19 cents and brightest PDUSTs were irregularly dearer. Brighter DUST1s gained up to 10 cents.
In the secondary catalogues, all descriptions were dearer.
Pakistan was a forceful buyer while Egypt remained strong. There was good support from Britain. --Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261
